integrity.proof_basis: Closed-form LP geometry, Cauchy--Schwarz extremality, strong law, half-normal central limit theorem.
integrity.scientific_scope: Exact deterministic envelope and asymptotic Gaussian collapse in explicitly specified box LPs.
integrity.verification_basis: Standalone finite arithmetic and seeded simulation corroboration; no external certification.

limitations: Single aggregated equality constraint, box-constrained LP, fixed variable and row normalization.
Exogenous independent Gaussian errors are not a model of a specific weight-update algorithm.
No claim for full two-stage stochastic MIP algorithms or independent scientific review.
Specialized older surrogate-constraint literature was not exhaustively accessible.
title: Sharp dual-weight robustness and Gaussian collapse window for aggregated linear constraints
